title: Supply Chain Attack on @ctrl/tinycolor
technical_mechanism: bundle.js postinstall ran TruffleHog; exfil to webhook.site; self-republished (Shai-Hulud wave 1)
summary: A malicious package '@ctrl/tinycolor' was discovered in the npm ecosystem. The attack involved credential-harvesting self-replicating worm (postinstall). Mechanism: bundle.js postinstall ran TruffleHog; exfil to webhook.site; self-republished (Shai-Hulud wave 1)
